newsitem.title: FRANCE: French wheat bids see 100,000 T at lowest refund.
newsitem.headline: French wheat bids see 100,000 T at lowest refund.

text.p: French wheat bids on Thursday started with 100,000 tonnes sought at the lowest refund level of 6.77 Ecus per tonne, implying the highest world price, grain traders said.
The cumulative total of bids rose to 250,000 tonnes for refunds up to a cut-off close to eight Ecus, they said.
The lowest refund bid of 6.77 Ecus per tonne equates to a world price of $159 to $160 per tonne, traders said.
In other bids, exporters sought a cumulative total of 290,000 tonnes up to a refund of 8.94 Ecus, they said.
The total rose to 315,000 tonnes for a maximum refund of 9.25 Ecus, 406,000 tonnes for 10 Ecus, 435,000 tonnes for 10.5 Ecus and 511,000 for just under 12 Ecus.
French grain office ONIC earlier reported total bids of 692,000 tonnes between 6.77 Ecus and 16.95 Ecus per tonne.
